data.gender_notes: Khyati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khyati is derived from the Sanskrit word 'khyati', which means 'to be creative' or 'to imagine'. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, wisdom, and creativity. A girl named Khyati is believed to possess these qualities in abundance. The name Khyati carries the meaning “Creativity, Imagination, Intuition” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khyati usually hope their child will grow to embody creativity, imagination, intuition and live with faith, good character and purpose.
